property_summary: For every admissible sequence of setup and state-changing calls, calling SetMinSum after Initialized must revert (leaving MinSum unchanged); the reference enforces this via the if(intitalized)revert() guard, while the buggy version loses the guard and allows SetMinSum to succeed, changing MinSum after initialization.
change_summary: Delete the `if(intitalized)revert();` guard, making SetMinSum always complete regardless of the initialized flag.
